name: Michael Knowles (Michael J. Knowles)
role: American conservative commentator and author (The Michael Knowles Show, Daily Wire)
summary: A Catholic traditionalist conservative who favours restricting abortion, defending traditional marriage and family, low taxes on the wealthy, tariffs and sharply lower immigration. He rejects redistribution and gender-identity politics and treats international law as not binding on the United States.

abortion-legal.rationale: Strongly agreed abortion should always be illegal unless the woman's life is threatened.

ban-cartels.rationale: Agreed, with the qualifier "certain monopolies", that a free market needs protection against monopolies.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Agreed that charity is better than Social Security for helping the disadvantaged, arguing charity is a moral exchange and taxation is not.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Strongly disagreed that there are no savage and civilized peoples, only different cultures.

death-penalty.rationale: Strongly agreed the death penalty should be an option for the most serious crimes, on retributive grounds.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Same quiz answer (disagreed that people should keep to their own kind), a milder reading for marriage across lines.

distribute-by-need.rationale: On camera he strongly disagreed with "from each according to his ability, to each according to his need", calling it Marx's idea, immoral and unworkable.

force-without-un.rationale: Strongly agreed military action defying international law is sometimes justified, because "there's no such thing as international law".

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: At CPAC 2023 said transgenderism must be eradicated from public life and praised a Kansas bill that bans it in practice.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Holds that men cannot become women and, in the quiz, called the view that the body has nothing to do with who you are a form of Gnosticism.

harm-principle.rationale: Disagreed that private conduct between consenting adults is no business of the state, saying all laws legislate morality.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Strongly disagreed that people with serious inheritable disabilities should be barred from reproducing, and condemned eliminating Down syndrome through abortion.

land-use-tenure.rationale: Strongly disagreed that land should not be a commodity: land will always be controlled by someone, and he wants that to be private people, not the government.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Disagreed that marijuana possession should not be a crime, saying it is a new foreign thing better kept out of the culture; he could not then favour legal recreational drugs generally.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Denied that international law exists as law, which puts national law first, though he was not asked about courts and constitutions directly.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Strongly agreed it matters that his child's school instil religious values and said public schools should teach the right ones, not gender theory.

one-party-rule.rationale: Disagreed that a one-party state has a significant advantage, pointing to the West winning the Cold War.

premarital-sex.rationale: Strongly agreed that sex outside marriage is usually immoral.

public-service-media.rationale: Said broadcasters may need public funding for certain public functions but that NPR should lose funding; points both ways.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Disagreed that it is better for different sorts of people to keep to their own kind, citing "neither Jew nor Greek" in Christ; a segregation law could not be held with that.

reduce-immigration.rationale: At CPAC 2025 said most Americans want drastically less immigration, legal and illegal, and says Trump must deport a lot of people.

rehabilitation.rationale: Strongly agreed punishment should matter more than rehabilitation: justice is the point of criminal justice, rehabilitation only secondary.

restrict-private-adult-pornography-acces.rationale: Disagreed (not strongly) that pornography for consenting adults should be legal, citing local wills and obscenity law.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: On his show (Mar 2024, Aug 2025) he said gay marriage "doesn't exist" and hoped justices overturn Obergefell, as marriage is the basic political unit.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Strongly agreed protectionism is sometimes necessary (China subsidies, barriers); separately says Trump must deliver his tariffs to protect American workers and security.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Strongly agreed that the rich are too highly taxed and said he hopes taxes get lowered.

traditional-family.rationale: Argues marriage is the fundamental political unit and that redefining family redefines society; in the quiz argued a child has a right to a mother and father.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Strongly agreed that those able to work who refuse the opportunity should not expect society's support.

notes: Most answers rest on his on-camera Political Compass quiz (about 2020, scored authoritarian right, he called it "traditional conservative"); he often rejected the quiz wording, so answers are used only where the item matches the statement. Searched and found no usable first-hand text for: NATO and alliances, Ukraine, Israel, elections and courts, climate and energy, school choice, speech. Daily Wire columns on file are short show transcripts without these topics; his book could not be read.
